ops.title: Hermes repart migration — pin facts (no in-tree repart+EFI; hand-seed ESP; AppArmor userns) + cutover outcomes 2026-07-13 (live on systemd-boot gen 2; remint needed CLIPROXY_API_KEY from metal's bundle; first-boot mkswap-vs-growfs race; builder-VM GC)

ops.body:
Verified 2026-07-13 against nixpkgs pin 6201e203 (nixos-25.05) for the raw-efi → `image.repart` migration of the hermes image:

- `image.repart` builds with `unshare --map-root-user fakeroot systemd-repart` — no KVM, no requiredSystemFeatures; output is `$out/<name>[_<version>].raw` + `repart-output.json`; compression is `mkEnableOption` (default OFF); `mkfsOptions` → `SYSTEMD_REPART_MKFS_OPTIONS_<FSTYPE>` env sets fs labels.
- 25.05 has NO in-tree repart+EFI bootable variant: `image.modules.raw-efi` → `virtualisation/disk-image.nix` is still make-disk-image/KVM. ESP must be hand-seeded (appliance-repart-image.nix test is the pattern).
- systemd-boot-builder.py contract: kernels copy to `EFI/nixos/<storedir>-<file>.efi`, entries are `loader/entries/nixos-generation-N.conf`; a plain switch runs `bootctl status` and RAISES if no systemd-boot is detected on the ESP (needs `--install-bootloader` otherwise) — so a seeded ESP must carry the real `systemd-bootaa64.efi` at both `EFI/systemd/` and `EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI` from `config.systemd.package`.
- The LIVE hermes VM's ESP is 256M (nixos-generators raw-efi keeps make-disk-image's default `bootSize=256M`) and GRUB reads kernels from ext4 — too small for systemd-boot kernel+initrd copies, which kills the in-guest-switch cutover; disk-replace (deploy-vm.sh) is the cutover path.
- /var/lib/tailscale is NOT on virtiofs (only /var/lib/hermes and /var/lib/yclaw-repo are, nixos/hermes.nix); disk-replace loses the node key — deploy-vm.sh already re-mints + nukes the old device.
- Ubuntu 24.04 (GitHub runners AND the cirruslabs tart builder VM) ships `kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1`, which can EPERM the repart `unshare` even inside the nix sandbox — mitigate with `sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0` before the build in both places.

Cutover outcomes (2026-07-13, live hermes on the repart image since then — verified through 3 reboots):

- **Cutover verified end-to-end**: EFI removable path → systemd-boot 257.10 → gen 1; root grew 6.8G→58G; store DB registered (gen 1, 1218 paths); first in-guest `redeploy.sh` switch converged to gen 2 REUSING the seeded kernel/initrd EFI files (no duplicate pair — the byte-matched naming worked); persistent node identity survived all reboots with zero re-mints. The switch built only 4 light derivations and did NOT drop the driving SSH (the tailscaled-restart failure mode is conditional, not universal).
- **remint-hermes-authkey.sh had a latent crash** on every disk-replace: hermes/env carries CLIPROXY_API_KEY whose ONLY home is metal's sops bundle (never the keychain). Fixed in b614d565: `cliproxy_key_from_metal_bundle` (scripts/lib/secrets.sh) decrypts it with the state-store age key via `sops --extract '["cliproxy"]["api-key"]'` — never mint fresh, it would desync metal's inbound :8317 bearer.
- **First-boot mkswap-vs-growfs race**: at the 25.05 pin, `boot.growPartition` is a STAGE-2 unit (`growpart.service`, after `-.mount`, before `systemd-growfs-root.service` — grow-partition.nix), so disk growth races unordered early services. The minimized repart root (~2G free) makes hermes's 8G swapfile dd ENOSPC on first boot (old make-disk-image had headroom, hiding it). Self-heals on reboot (size-mismatch guard recreates). Fix: `systemd.services.mkswap-var-swapfile = { after/wants = [ "systemd-growfs-root.service" ]; }` in hermes.nix.
- **Builder-VM disk fills after ~4 image builds** (80G disk, ~77G used → `mv` ENOSPC mid-install-phase): `tailscale`-less builder, recover with `nix-collect-garbage -d` in-guest (freed 49G). Consider a pre-build GC guard or BUILDER_DISK_GB bump.
- **`tart run --no-graphics` does NOT wire guest serial to stdio** — scratch-boot debugging needs `--serial-path` with a host pty.
- deploy-vm.sh (and anything kc_read-based) must run in Terminal.app, not an agent session: [[background-session-keychain]].

Related: [[deploy-pipeline-fixes-2026-06]], [[redeploy-in-place-2026-06]], [[background-session-keychain]].
